$schema_note: Build brief for an AI coding agent. Read 'build' first, then 'design' and 'motion', then render 'content' exactly as written. Do not invent metrics, employers, or links. Design: retro-modern paper style with extra-bold modern sans for emphasis.

build.styling: Tailwind CSS (design tokens as CSS variables in globals.css, mapped in tailwind config)
build.content_source: Copy 'content' from this file into /content/portfolio.ts as typed constants; components read from there, never hard-code copy.

nav.type: sticky top bar, translucent paper background with backdrop blur after 24px scroll

requirements: Fully responsive; 16px side gutter on mobile, max content width 1120px
Semantic HTML, visible focus rings, alt text, aria-labels on icon links
Copy assets/arjun-portrait.webp to /public; render with next/image, priority, sizes set
Data science content is academic and personal only; never present it as professional ML experience
Toggle and outline buttons must show readable ink text in their resting state, not only on hover (set explicit color/background; never rely on inherited button styles)

variant_system.how: One shared layout and component set. Each route loads a variant object from 'variants' and merges it over 'content'. Only copy, ordering, emphasis and featured projects change; design and motion stay identical.
variant_system.switcher: Small mono-text toggle in the nav: FULL STACK / DATA SCIENCE. Shared layoutId underline slides between them.
variant_system.seo: Each route has its own <title>, meta description and Open Graph text from the variant.
variant_system.resume_files: Put the two PDFs in /public/resumes/ with the filenames given in each variant.

hero_layout.desktop: Two columns: text left (eyebrow, extra-bold name, italic accent word, tagline, CTAs, stats), portrait right at ~40% width, top-aligned with the name. Mono caption under the photo: 'CORK, IE · OPEN TO WORK'.
hero_layout.mobile: Portrait stacks above the name at 70% width, left-aligned.

design.direction: Minimal retro-modern. Warm paper background, ink-black text, one punchy accent. Like a 70s technical manual reprinted today: generous whitespace, thin rules, monospace labels. Extra-bold modern sans gives it punch in key places.

display.use: Hero name, section titles, stat numbers, footer name
display.notes: Modern extra-bold grotesque with a slight retro character. Tight tracking (-0.035em), line-height 0.95.

accent_serif.use: At most one emphasis word per headline, in accent colour. Never for body or long text.

retro_details: Section numbers in mono: '01 / SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT'
1px rules between sections and around cards (color: rule)
Very subtle paper grain overlay (SVG noise, 4% opacity, pointer-events none)
Tech tags as small pill outlines in mono
Hard offset shadow on hover instead of blur shadows: 4px 4px 0 ink
avoid: Serif for whole headlines (italic accent word only)

principles: Ease-out for entering, ease-in-out for moving; never linear for UI
Motion should explain or reward, not decorate; one hero moment, everything else quiet
prefers-reduced-motion: disable translate/scale, keep opacity fades at 150ms
Every animation must be skippable or finish under 1s after the first visit; nothing blocks reading or clicking

patterns.hero_entrance: Extra-bold name reveals word by word from below a mask (y 100% → 0 inside overflow-hidden lines), stagger 70ms; italic accent word arrives last with a 4° skew settling to 0.
patterns.section_reveal: whileInView once, amount 0.2: y 16px → 0, opacity 0 → 1, 500ms, children stagger 50ms
patterns.project_card_hover: Card translates (-4px, -4px) and gains hard shadow 4px 4px 0 ink; category colour strip on left widens 4px → 8px; arrow nudges 4px right. 200ms ease-out.
patterns.link_hover: Underline draws left to right via scaleX 0 → 1 (origin left), 220ms; on leave retracts to the right.
patterns.tag_hover: Fill with category soft colour, 150ms. No movement.
patterns.button_hover_press: Hover: translate(-2px,-2px) + hard shadow 3px 3px 0 accent. Active: scale 0.97, shadow removed, 100ms.
patterns.nav_active_indicator: Shared layoutId pill under the active section link, spring transition.
patterns.experience_timeline: Vertical rule draws downward (scaleY) as the section scrolls into view; dot per role pops in with scale 0.6 → 1.
patterns.stat_counters: Extra-bold numbers count up once on first view, 900ms ease-out.
patterns.cursor: Do not replace the system cursor.
patterns.intro_loader: First visit per session only: mono counter 000→100 in the corner (~900ms), then the paper panel slides up (translateY -100%, 600ms in_out) and the hero entrance starts. Skipped on reduced motion and on variant switches.
patterns.scroll_progress: 2px accent bar fixed at the very top, scaleX driven by useScroll + useSpring (stiffness 200, damping 40).
patterns.nav_link_roll: Nav link text is duplicated in an overflow-hidden span; on hover the top copy slides up and the second slides in from below (translateY 0 → -100%), 250ms ease-out.
patterns.section_heading_rule: Title rises from a mask, then a 1px ink rule draws across beneath it (scaleX 0 → 1, origin left, 700ms).
patterns.portrait: Grayscale. On load: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0) reveal from the bottom, 900ms in_out. On hover: image scales 1.00 → 1.03 inside its frame and an accent offset frame slides from (0,0) to (10px,10px) behind it, 300ms.
patterns.tech_marquee: A single row of stack names in mono between hero and about, scrolling slowly (40s loop, CSS transform). Pauses on hover; each name turns accent on hover. Static wrapped list on reduced motion.
patterns.magnetic_cta: Primary CTA buttons drift up to 6px toward the pointer while hovered (spring stiffness 300, damping 20), snap back on leave. Desktop pointer only.
patterns.project_card_tags: On card hover the tech tags fill with the category soft colour in a left-to-right stagger of 30ms.
patterns.experience_expand: Each role shows 2 bullets; a 'More' toggle expands the rest with AnimatePresence height auto + opacity, 300ms; the plus icon rotates 45° to an ×.
patterns.variant_switch: Switching FULL STACK ↔ DATA SCIENCE: an accent/teal panel wipes across the screen (clip-path, 700ms total), the accent colour cross-fades, and sections re-run their stagger.
patterns.copy_email: Clicking the email copies it; the copy icon morphs to a check (scale 0.6 → 1 + opacity), and a small mono 'COPIED' chip rises 8px and fades after 1.5s.
patterns.back_to_top: Square ink button; appears after 1 viewport of scroll (scale 0.8 → 1 + opacity, 200ms); hover lifts with hard shadow.
patterns.footer_name: Huge extra-bold name in the footer; each letter lifts 6px on hover (spring), neighbours lift 3px.
patterns.page_load_order: Loader → nav fades in (200ms) → hero words → portrait reveal → stats count → marquee starts. Total under 2.2s on first visit, under 1s afterwards.
patterns.mono_label_scramble: Section numbers and eyebrows scramble through random characters for ~400ms on first view and on hover, then settle. Fixed-width mono so layout never shifts.

content.about: I'm a full stack developer with three years of production experience in healthcare and logistics. I've built Angular and React front ends on ASP.NET Core microservices for a platform used by 150+ hospitals, where I cut scheduling queries from 10+ seconds to under 1. At Cydez I built shipment and warehouse APIs in C# and EF Core for Maersk, and set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker and Azure DevOps. I like owning a feature end to end: schema, API, UI and tests. I also hold a First Class Honours MSc in Data Science.

software_development.title: Medical Claims AI Platform
software_development.summary: Full-stack platform that turns unstructured medical claim documents into structured, reviewable data.
highlights: React front end, ASP.NET Core API and PostgreSQL, with a FastAPI service handling LLM-based document understanding
ETL pipeline that ingests and normalises claim documents into a structured schema, with row-level access controls and integrity checks before data reaches reports
Secure authentication, PDF processing, claim risk analysis, document-grounded RAG chat and real-time dashboards
Containerised with Docker, shipped through a CI/CD pipeline, and self-hosted

software_development.title: MCP Server for Analytics Tooling
software_development.summary: A Model Context Protocol server that lets AI coding agents query live analytics data.
highlights: Exposes internal data endpoints to Claude Code so agent sessions can query results and generate dashboard code from live data

data_science.title: UAV Battery Power Prediction
data_science.summary: End-to-end ML pipeline predicting short-term drone energy use from real PX4 flight telemetry.
highlights: Processed large-scale battery, voltage and power time series with correlation and mutual-information feature selection
Benchmarked PCA, Random Forest, XGBoost, LSTM, Bi-LSTM and Autoencoder models, and identified the best approach for anomaly scoring on flight sequences

data_science.title: Pill Defect Detection
data_science.summary: AI quality inspection for pharmaceutical pills using an autoencoder trained on the MVTec AD dataset.
highlights: PyTorch autoencoder flags defects by reconstruction error
Gradio interface with SQLite logging of inspections

data_science.title: Chest X-ray Anomaly Detection
data_science.summary: Convolutional autoencoder for pneumonia anomaly detection, compared against a PCA reconstruction-error baseline.
highlights: Kaggle pneumonia dataset
CNN autoencoder vs PCA baseline

data_science.title: Semiconductor Fault Detection
data_science.summary: Fault classification on the highly imbalanced SECOM manufacturing dataset.
highlights: PCA for dimensionality reduction and SMOTE for class imbalance
Benchmarked k-NN, Decision Tree and SVM classifiers

data_science.title: Sarcasm Detection
data_science.summary: Naive Bayes text classifier with TF-IDF features for detecting sarcasm in written text.
highlights: End-to-end NLP workflow from preprocessing to evaluation

data_science.title: Pharmacy Sales BI Dashboard
data_science.summary: Sales analytics on pharmacy transaction data: revenue trends, branch KPIs, GIS mapping and Sankey flows.
highlights: Python data prep feeding Tableau dashboards

data_science.title: Tweet Sentiment Classifier
data_science.summary: Multinomial Naive Bayes written from scratch with Laplace smoothing.

data_science.title: Sensor Data PCA Studies
data_science.summary: Dimensionality reduction and clustering on three sensor datasets: human activity (smartphone), daily and sports activity (wearables), and gas sensor drift.
highlights: PCA, LDA, K-Means and DBSCAN across real sensor data
Built REST APIs for shipment creation, status tracking and warehouse inventory in ASP.NET Core and EF Core, within a microservices platform serving Maersk and other global shipping clients
Refactored LINQ and EF Core queries across delivery, warehouse and shipment modules to cut data-access latency on core reads
Shipped Angular features against backend microservices and reviewed code for junior developers in a 20-person Scrum team
Automated builds and deployments with GitHub Actions and Docker, and contributed to Azure DevOps pipeline configuration
Developed ASP.NET Core microservices for patient management, scheduling and records on a platform used daily by 150+ hospitals across India and the Middle East
Optimised PostgreSQL queries in the scheduling module, cutting booking and rescheduling times from over 10 seconds to under 1 second at peak
Built front-end features in Angular, React and TypeScript, and analytics dashboards for clinical and admin teams
Wrote unit tests with Jasmine and Karma; grew from junior developer to mentoring new hires and running code reviews
Led 3 of 5 production releases on a 5-person team shipping Angular and REST API features for clinical workflow clients
Taught full stack development to batches of 60 students (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, Node.js)
